req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-019 requires GET /openapi.json to return HTTP 2xx with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path returns 200 with correct content-type and openapi key starting with '3.'; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — schema contains required top-level OpenAPI 3.x keys (openapi, info, paths) with exact string values matching app configuration; (4) DT — info block contains exact title and version matching FastAPI app init; (5) BVA — paths block contains all registered route keys. Mutation resilience: exact status codes, exact string equality on openapi version prefix, exact title/version strings, exact content-type substring, exact key presence checks.

tests.name: test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type
trace: R-TASK-019: system shall serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)

test_openapi_json_returns_200_with_json_content_type()

actions: Check paths block for each registered route

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_paths_contains_all_registered_routes():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    paths = r.json()["paths"]
    assert "/" in paths
    assert "/tasks/" in paths
    assert "/tasks/{task_id}" in paths

test_openapi_json_paths_contains_all_registered_routes()

tests.name: test_openapi_json_openapi_version_is_exactly_3x_not_2x
actions: Check openapi version string does not start with '2.'
trace: R-TASK-019: specification must be OpenAPI 3.x, not Swagger 2.x
BVA: boundary between OpenAPI 2.x and 3.x version strings
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_openapi_json_openapi_version_is_exactly_3x_not_2x():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    openapi_ver = r.json()["openapi"]
    assert openapi_ver.startswith("3.")
    assert not openapi_ver.startswith("2.")
    assert not openapi_ver.startswith("1.")
    assert openapi_ver != "2.0"

test_openapi_json_openapi_version_is_exactly_3x_not_2x()
